_comment: Sponsor inventory — set prices, direct placement, NO auctions. To add a sponsor, append an object to the right sponsors array (or to app_banners.banners under the app's slug) with: name, tagline (<=90 chars), url, optional mark (defaults to first letter), optional image (300x180 or null), start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD). A sponsor appears only while today is inside [start, end]; expired entries are skipped at build time with a console note. Header and footer rotate fairly through ALL active sponsors (3 visible at a time, equal screen time, sequential order). App banners show on that app's page. The lifetime slot is inquiry-only: Jessyka handles it manually, one sponsor pinned permanently. Prices in USD.

header.label: Header rotation
header.position: Three sponsor units under the hero, above search, rotating fairly through every active header sponsor.

footer.label: Footer rotation
footer.position: Sponsor units above the site footer, rotating fairly through every active footer sponsor.

app_banners.label: App profile banner
app_banners.position: Banner on the sponsor's own app page (/apps/<slug>.html).
app_banners._price_note: FLAG: $25/mo was picked for footer parity — Jessyka did not set this price. Confirm the price before selling any app banner.

lifetime.label: Lifetime pin
lifetime.position: Pinned permanently at the top of the homepage, above the header rotation. It never rotates out, never expires.
lifetime._note: Inquiry-only: Jessyka handles lifetime deals manually via X DMs. Add the sponsor object here once a deal closes. A missing end date means forever.

_sponsor_shape.name: Product name
_sponsor_shape.mark: ◆ (optional, defaults to first letter of name)
